id: title:jakesciotto:guard humanize breakdown label against none series label

review.posthog_relevance: Prevents potential runtime AttributeError in trend visualization when HogQL returns a series without a label, name, or breakdown value.
review.reason: The change consists of P1.F2.H1, which adds a None-handling guard to `humanize_breakdown_label` to prevent an AttributeError, and P1.F1.H1, which adds a regression test for this behavior. This is a localized, bounded implementation and test correction. While it could prevent a runtime crash in trend visualization, the implementation is narrow and does not demonstrate broader system
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether HogQL execution paths can produce unlabelled series; this is not established by the test or implementation alone.
